clips.title: The story
paras: Deliver the News is a quest concluding the plight of the Windfield family orchard in Skywall. After helping Aamelia secure the farm, the adventurer travels to Valanaar to deliver tidings of their safety to an anxious Alvarion Windfield.

Deliver the News marks the resolution of an ordeal at the Windfield family orchard. Having stepped in to save the farm from an impending crisis, the adventurer receives heartfelt thanks from Aamelia, who is ready to put the danger behind them. With the orchard secured, the immediate priority shifts to reassuring Alvarion Windfield, who fled to the settlement of Valanaar to plead for assistance.

In Valanaar, Alvarion Windfield is overcome with emotion upon learning that his family and home are safe. Having left for the city believing his search for help was a desperate, almost vain hope, the traveler's success evokes for him the legendary heroes remembered from before his people arrived in Skywall. With their home saved, the Windfield family extends an enduring welcome to their savior.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... Thank you, friend.

If you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... Our family.
He doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Alvarion's eyes tear up as you finish retelling the story of what happened at the orchard.

I don't know how to thank you, friend. I came to Valanaar looking for hope. A vain hope, I was almost certain. But instead I found a hero. A real hero, like the stories from before we came to Skywall.
I'll never forget what you did for us, friend. You'll always be welcome at the Windfield home.
